items.title: Adyen hires Klarna's Niclas Neglen as CFO
items.summary: Adyen N.V. (AMS: ADYEN) today announces the nomination of Niclas Neglen as Chief Financial Officer (CFO) and member of the statutory Management Board, effective February 1, 2027, subject to regulatory and shareholder approval.
items.why: Adyen poaching Klarna's CFO is a major, unexpected executive move impacting two fintech giants.

items.title: Adyen snaps up Klarna CFO
items.summary: p Niclas Negl eacute;n will begin at the Dutch payments processing firm Feb. 1. The move gives Adyen a permanent successor to Ethan Tandowsky, the company rsquo;s previous CFO, who left Aug. 31. /p
items.why: Adyen poaching Klarna's CFO is a major, unexpected executive move impacting two fintech giants.

items.title: SoFi Bank goes live with stablecoin settlement across Mastercard network
items.summary: SoFi Bank has joined forces with Mastercard to migrate its full card programme to blockchain settlement using its own SoFiUSD stablecoin.
items.why: Major shift in payments infrastructure as a bank migrates card settlements to its own stablecoin.

items.title: FCA: Banks need to up their game to crack down on money mules
items.summary: Financial firms are shutting down hundreds of thousands of suspected money mule accounts, but organised criminal groups are still shifting dirty money through multiple bank accounts before cashing out.
items.why: FCA warns banks to strengthen controls as criminal networks bypass current money mule detection.

items.title: Trustly slashes 200 jobs
items.summary: Swedish open banking outfit Trustly is cutting a quarter of its staff as part of an effort to cut costs and prioritise profitable growth markets.
items.why: Major open banking fintech cuts 25% of workforce in strategic pivot to profitability.

items.title: Asic strengthens AI safeguards
items.summary: ASIC is strengthening safeguards for automated and AI-enabled trading while streamlining regulatory requirements for securities and futures market participants under incoming changes to its Market Integrity Rules (MIRs).
items.why: ASIC is updating Market Integrity Rules to strengthen safeguards for AI-enabled trading.

items.title: The Clearing House taps Quant for tokenised deposit network
items.summary: The Clearing House has picked UK-based programmable money infrastructure provider Quant to power a new interoperable payments network that will enable US financial institutions of all sizes to clear and settle tokenised deposit transactions.
items.why: The Clearing House launches new tokenised deposit network, a significant US payments infrastructure move.

items.title: UK banks pilot tokenised deposit transactions
items.summary: UK banks have collaborated to complete the first live customer transactions using tokenised sterling deposits.
items.why: UK banks complete first live customer transactions using tokenised sterling deposits.

items.title: IBM integrates digital asset platform with Swift shared ledger
items.summary: IBM is now letting its digital asset platform clients connect to permissioned blockchain networks, including Swift’s shared ledger.
items.why: IBM integrating its digital asset platform with Swift's shared ledger is a significant fintech interoperability development.

items.title: Revolut customers impacted by new data breach
items.summary: Revolut has found itself embroiled in a second data breach in a matter of days after some its customers were impacted by a security incident at US broker DriveWealth.
items.why: Security incident and data breach at a partner broker affecting major fintech customers.

items.title: Tax compliance platform Numeral raises $100m
items.summary: Numeral, the AI-powered sales tax compliance platform, today announced a $100 million Series C led by Insight Partners, with participation from Salesforce Ventures, Geodesic, Benchmark, Mayfield, FCVC, Y Combinator and Uncork.
items.why: Major $100m Series C funding round for an AI-powered tax compliance platform.

items.title: FedNow to enable cross-border payments
items.summary: The US Federal Reserve is pushing ahead with plans to enable participants in its FedNow real-time payments system to make cross-border transfers.
items.why: Major expansion of FedNow real-time payments system to cross-border transfers.

items.title: Online scams agreement signed between UK and Cambodian governments
items.summary: The UK and Cambodia will work together to tackle networks of illegal scam centres, locations where sophisticated fraud techniques are deployed and scaled to target thousands of victims.
items.why: New international government agreement to target cross-border online scam networks.

items.title: Bitget hit by $387.5 million hack
items.summary: Bitget has halted customer withdrawals after hackers that the crypto exchange suspects are linked to North Korea stole more than $380 million.
items.why: Major crypto exchange hacked for nearly $390 million with withdrawals halted.

items.title: US prosecutors seize Tether-linked payment firm's bank accounts - FT
items.summary: US federal prosecutors have seized bank accounts belonging Capstone, a payments business working on behalf of stablecoin issuer Tether and its sister exchange Bitfinex, according to the Financial Times.
items.why: Federal law enforcement action seizing bank accounts connected to Tether payment processing.

items.title: Revolut gets green light to buy Argentinian bank
items.summary: Revolut has received the regulatory go-ahead to acquire small Argentinian lender Banco Cetelem from BNP Paribas.
items.why: Regulatory approval for Revolut to acquire an Argentinian bank and expand presence.

items.title: Nubank in talks to take over Monzo
items.summary: Brazilian neobank Nubank is reportedly eyeing a takeover of UK digital bank Monzo, in a deal that would value the British challenger at $10 billion.
items.why: Major cross-border fintech M&A talks valuing Monzo at $10 billion.

items.title: Swift provides cross-border gateway to Bizum, PayID and Pix users
items.summary: Swift has launched an initiative to bring the pay-by-alias experience of domestic national payment systems, Bizum, PayID and Pix, to cross-border transactions, enabling consumers to send money internationally using a mobile number or email address, rather than account details.
items.why: Swift launching cross-border pay-by-alias connecting domestic payment networks like Pix and PayID is a major infrastructure expansion.

items.title: FCA secures money back for victims of crypto fraud
items.summary: Victims of a £1.5m crypto investment fraud will recover lost funds after the Financial Conduct Authority obtained confiscation orders against Raymondip Bedi and Patrick Mavanga.
items.why: FCA secures confiscation orders to return funds to fraud victims.

items.title: Valley Bank to buy digital SME banking platform Bluevine
items.summary: Regional lender Valley National Bank has agreed to buy SME digital banking platform Bluevine for around $340 million in cash and stock.
items.why: Major $340 million acquisition of SME banking platform Bluevine by Valley National Bank.

items.title: Watchdog again blocks sale of RAC WA insurance arm to east-coast giant
items.summary: Australia's competition watchdog again blocks the sale of WA's largest insurer to an east-coast industry giant, reiterating the purchase would likely reduce competition in the state's insurance market.
items.why: Competition watchdog blocks major regional insurer sale, protecting insurance market competition.

items.title: Breaking: NAB customers experiencing phone and internet banking outages
items.summary: NAB is experiencing a digital outage across multiple platforms including its mobile app, internet banking and phone services.
items.why: Major national bank experiencing widespread digital outage affecting mobile app, internet, and phone banking services.

items.title: Oil platform 'a warning' as government considers new decommissioning rules
items.summary: The federal government is paying to keep an oil platform safe after its owners collapsed. The Cliff Head platform off the WA coast has raised fresh questions about the strength of Australia's offshore decommissioning laws.
items.why: Government considering new decommissioning rules and liability laws following corporate collapse.

items.title: Fintech Avant applies for OCC charter
items.summary: figure div img src="https://imgproxy.divecdn.com/Ynio67rfYurR3M67S-xE1Tz5L6iqiEEwnnzmJ0vwdmA/g:ce/rs:fill:1600:900:1/Z3M6Ly9kaXZlc2l0ZS1zdG9yYWdlL2RpdmVpbWFnZS9HZXR0eUltYWdlcy0xMjgzNTM4MzYzLmpwZw==.webp"/ /div /figure p A charter from the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency would allow the Chicago-based lender to expand its credit products, diversify beyond them, and reduce its cost of funds, the CEO said. /p
items.why: Major fintech seeking a national bank charter is a significant regulatory development.

items.title: All consumers to pay for EV chargers under power monopoly 'waiver'
items.summary: A bitter fight is brewing between EV charging companies and poles-and-wires companies, and now a regulator has weighed in.
items.why: Regulator waiver allows power monopolies to pass EV infrastructure costs to all consumers.

items.title: Breaking: Unemployment rate reaches post-COVID era high of 4.6pc in August
items.summary: The national unemployment rate rises to 4.6 per cent, up from 4.5 per cent in July, in seasonally adjusted and trend terms.
items.why: Unemployment rate reaching a post-COVID high is a significant macroeconomic data surprise.

items.title: Analyst warns diesel could top $4 and rationing possible if US ban proceeds
items.summary: Saul Kavonic says the US's proposed diesel export ban is "probably the most worrying development we've seen in global fuel markets since the [Middle East] war began".
items.why: Potential US diesel export ban threatening extreme price spikes and rationing is a major market shock.

items.title: Breaking: Lenders pull out of Bathla group as construction work halts across sites
items.summary: Building work has stopped at sites and company is down to skeleton staff.
items.why: Lenders pulling out of a major developer and halting construction is a significant, unexpected market event.

items.title: Exclusive: Revolut customers hit by fresh security breach
items.why: Exclusive report detailing a fresh security breach at major fintech Revolut.

items.title: Fed proposes stablecoin rules
items.summary: figure div img src="https://imgproxy.divecdn.com/-DqnjKLPOoTxBe41IMfQlKwOAe4ddPFzjshnZ1A3j-c/g:nowe:28:0/c:2730:1542/rs:fill:1600:900:1/Z3M6Ly9kaXZlc2l0ZS1zdG9yYWdlL2RpdmVpbWFnZS9HZXR0eUltYWdlcy0yMjUwMjQyNTQzLmpwZw==.webp"/ /div /figure p In a statement issued alongside proposed rules, Fed Gov. Michael Barr said stablecoins ldquo;will only be stable if they can be reliably and promptly redeemed at par in a range of conditions. rdquo; /p
items.why: Federal Reserve proposes new regulatory rules governing stablecoins.

items.title: Monzo in talks about a sale to Nubank, reports
items.why: Major potential cross-border fintech acquisition between two leading digital banks.

items.title: China, US agree to AI dialogue, $42b in tariff cuts during state visit
items.summary: The tariff reductions are set to apply to US exports such as agricultural goods, wood and cosmetics, as well as US imports including small appliances, toys, decorations.
items.why: Major US-China policy agreement involving $42 billion in tariff cuts and structured AI dialogue.
